style.why: The hook (scoring on three major debuts in days) is memorable and the manager list works well as a narrowing clue. However, it reads slightly like a list of achievements rather than a connected story with tension or twist, which keeps it from a perfect 5.
style.fix: Connect the sentences more fluidly to create a narrative arc. For example: 'I scored on my first-team, European & Premier League debuts all within days of each other. Yet despite that early success, I was later recognised by the government for my work as a philanthropist rather than just my football
